exposure: Parental history of diseases (overweight, hypertension, diabetes)
outcome: Prevalence of metabolically healthy overweight and obesity (MHOO)
Prevalence of metabolically unhealthy overweight and obesity (MUOO)
Risk factors for MHO and MUO
cohort: 15,114 Chinese children and adolescents aged 7-18 years.
finding: The prevalence of MHO, MUO, MHOO, and MUOO was higher in boys than in girls, with several environmental and genetic risk factors showing significant sex differences.
mod_finding: Boys born via cesarean section did not have a significantly different risk of MUO compared to boys born vaginally, but girls born via cesarean section had a significantly higher risk of MUO compared to girls born vaginally.
